name: WdLineStyle
description: Specifies the border style for an object.

constants.name: wdLineStyleNone
constants.description: No border.

constants.name: wdLineStyleSingle
constants.description: A single solid line.

constants.name: wdLineStyleDot
constants.description: Dots.

constants.name: wdLineStyleDashSmallGap
constants.description: A dash followed by a small gap.

constants.name: wdLineStyleDashLargeGap
constants.description: A dash followed by a large gap.

constants.name: wdLineStyleDashDot
constants.description: A dash followed by a dot.

constants.name: wdLineStyleDashDotDot
constants.description: A dash followed by two dots.

constants.name: wdLineStyleDouble
constants.description: Double solid lines.

constants.name: wdLineStyleTriple
constants.description: Three solid thin lines.

constants.name: wdLineStyleThinThickSmallGap
constants.description: An internal single thin solid line surrounded by a single thick solid line with a small gap between them.

constants.name: wdLineStyleThickThinSmallGap
constants.description: An internal single thick solid line surrounded by a single thin solid line with a small gap between them.

constants.name: wdLineStyleThinThickThinSmallGap
constants.description: An internal single thin solid line surrounded by a single thick solid line surrounded by a single thin solid line with a small gap between all lines.

constants.name: wdLineStyleThinThickMedGap
constants.description: An internal single thin solid line surrounded by a single thick solid line with a medium gap between them.

constants.name: wdLineStyleThickThinMedGap
constants.description: An internal single thick solid line surrounded by a single thin solid line with a medium gap between them.

constants.name: wdLineStyleThinThickThinMedGap
constants.description: An internal single thin solid line surrounded by a single thick solid line surrounded by a single thin solid line with a medium gap between all lines.

constants.name: wdLineStyleThinThickLargeGap
constants.description: An internal single thin solid line surrounded by a single thick solid line with a large gap between them.

constants.name: wdLineStyleThickThinLargeGap
constants.description: An internal single thick solid line surrounded by a single thin solid line with a large gap between them.

constants.name: wdLineStyleThinThickThinLargeGap
constants.description: An internal single thin solid line surrounded by a single thick solid line surrounded by a single thin solid line with a large gap between all lines.

constants.name: wdLineStyleSingleWavy
constants.description: A single wavy solid line.

constants.name: wdLineStyleDoubleWavy
constants.description: Double wavy solid lines.

constants.name: wdLineStyleDashDotStroked
constants.description: A dash followed by a dot stroke, thus rendering a border similar to a barber pole.

constants.name: wdLineStyleEmboss3D
constants.description: The border appears to have a 3D embossed look.

constants.name: wdLineStyleEngrave3D
constants.description: The border appears to have a 3D engraved look.

constants.name: wdLineStyleOutset
constants.description: The border appears to be outset.

constants.name: wdLineStyleInset
constants.description: The border appears to be inset.
